protocol.protocolTimestampMeaning: Protocol fixed before bulk collection and fitting, after two schema-only source probes; this is not a historical preregistration.
protocol.selectionMetric: 2024 exact halftime score negative log probability, common evaluable games
protocol.fullTimeModelPolicy: Reuse existing FT selected hyperparameters; refit only on the corresponding earlier FT rows. Never change existing FT frozen artifacts.
protocol.model: P(FT_H,FT_A) times independent Binomial(HT_H;FT_H,q_H) and Binomial(HT_A;FT_A,q_A)
protocol.estimator: Separate league/home-away time-weighted ratio of halftime goals to fulltime goals; no arbitrary fixed 0.5 prediction
assumptions: Conditional on the FT pair, each team's goals are independently assigned to the first half with a constant league/side probability
No score-state, substitution, stoppage-time or player effect is estimated
protocol.sourcePopulation: Existing accepted REGULATION_FT histories, 2190 EPL and 805 UCL rows; all remain in collection coverage denominators
protocol.sourceExtraction: Explicit period-1 values or exactly two ordered period totals, corroborated against a complete two-half scoring-event timeline; period sums must equal FT
protocol.diagnosticInterpretation: 2025 is a retrospective diagnostic already used in FT development, not an untouched final test
protocol.postProcessingCalibration: No unconstrained independent HT/FT post-processing. Empirical binomial shares estimated on training; report outcome calibration diagnostics without claiming verified calibration.
protocol.promotion: No betting, profitability, final acceptance, confidence bound or PIT certification follows from these diagnostics
